title: Grammar Cheat Sheet
description: The whole B1 grammar syllabus on one page. Perfect for the night before the exam.

blocks.heading: Tenses in one look
items: Present Simple — facts, habits, timetables: The bus leaves at eight.
Present Continuous — now, around now, arrangements: I'm staying with friends this week.
Past Simple — finished time: We visited Krakow in June.
Past Continuous — scene-setting: It was raining when we arrived.
Present Perfect — experience / present results, no finished time: I've never broken a bone.
blocks.tip: Finished time word (yesterday, in 2019, last week) = Past Simple. No exceptions.

blocks.heading: Conditionals
items: Zero: If you heat water, it boils.
First: If it rains, we'll stay in.
Second: If I won the lottery, I'd buy a boat.
unless = if ... not · Time clauses take present simple: I'll phone you when I land.

blocks.heading: Passive
items: be + past participle: is made, was built, will be delivered.
Use it when the action matters more than the doer.
Modals: must be worn, can be found.

blocks.heading: Reported speech
items: Backshift: like → liked, is working → was working, will → would.
Questions → statement order: She asked where I lived.
say + clause · tell + person · told me (not) to do.

blocks.heading: Modals
items: must / have to = obligation · mustn't = NO! · don't have to = not necessary.
should = advice · might/may = maybe · can = ability · could = polite.
Modals + bare infinitive (no to).

blocks.heading: Comparisons
items: -er than / more ... than · the -est / the most ...
good-better-best · bad-worse-worst · far-further.
as ... as · not as ... as · too + adj · adj + enough.

blocks.heading: Verb patterns
items: -ing: enjoy, finish, stop, mind, suggest + prepositions.
to + infinitive: want, hope, decide, plan, would like.
stop doing (quit) vs stop to do (pause for a purpose).
